mapper.insert: insert into mall_footprint (user_id, product_id, visit_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{productId}, 1, now(), now()) on duplicate key update visit_count = visit_count + 1, update_time = now()
mapper.select: select id, user_id, product_id, visit_count, create_time, update_time from mall_footprint where user_id = #{userId} order by update_time desc, id desc

select p.id, p.category_id, c.name as category_name, p.brand_id, b.name as brand_name, p.name, p.subtitle, p.main_image, p.price_low, p.price_high, p.stock, p.sales, p.rating, p.status, p.sort, p.create_time, p.update_time from mall_product p left join mall_category c on c.id = p.category_id left join mall_brand b on b.id = p.brand_id where p.id in
#{pid}
mapper.delete: delete from mall_footprint where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId}
